works.title: Autonomous Item-Handling & Fruit-Harvesting Robots
works.description: A unified series of mobile manipulators for fully-autonomous fruit detection, ripeness recognition and robotic harvesting into designated bins, as well as autonomous grasping & QR-code-based sorting of household items.
works.tech: Jetson Orin NX, STM32F407, Mid-360 LiDAR, YOLOv5, OpenCV, POINT-LIO, FAST-LIO, Mecanum Wheels, Stepper Motors, Laser Ranging

works.title: Rubik’s-Cube Solving Dual-Arm Robot
works.description: High-speed 3×3×3 Rubik’s-cube restoration with two 4-DOF arms in the shortest possible time; achieves sub-10-s solves via binary-tree move pruning and k-means++ color clustering.
works.tech: STM32G431, USB 2.0 Camera, OpenCV, kmeans++, Servo Motors, Binary-Tree Pruning Algorithm

works.title: RoboMaster Multi-Robot Autonomous Combat System
works.description: RM 2025 team-level entry: design & field infantry, sentry ,hero and engineering robots that can navigate, auto-aim and fight in a 3-vs-3 tactical match; tasks include armor-plate vision tracking, LiDAR-based navigation, coordinated strike and real-time multi-robot command.
works.tech: Jetson Orin NX, STM32F407, Mid-360 LiDAR, YOLOv5, TensorRT, OpenCV, PnP, EKF, Omni-Directional Wheels, 3508/6020 Motors
